package com.codex.autopilot.core.farming;

/** The broad state of a patch. Adapted from RuneLite's Time Tracking plugin. */
public enum CropState
{
	HARVESTABLE,
	GROWING,
	DISEASED,
	DEAD,
	EMPTY,
	FILLING
}
